DitherNumber.value: The number to show. Change it and the digits roll to the new value.
DitherNumber.decimals: Most decimals. Trailing zeros are left out, and thousands get a separator.
DitherNumber.prefix: Text before the number, such as "$" or "+".
DitherNumber.suffix: Text after the number, such as "%" or " ms".
DitherNumber.size: sm, md, lg, xl or display: 24, 36, 60, 96 and 112px, each a little tighter.
DitherNumber.accent: Colour a digit takes while it moves, fading back as it lands. Set it to color to keep one colour.
DitherNumber.stagger: Milliseconds between one digit starting and the next.
DitherNumber.animate: When false the number shows its value straight away.
DitherNumber.matrix: The dither pattern of the faded edges.
DitherNumber.background: Colour behind the number. The faded edges are drawn in it, so match the surface the number sits on.
